subject: onboarding-review-delivery
title: Onboarding review delivery
request: Confirm that a new customer can receive and open a Nib review request from the Cloudflare preview.
change: Deploys the account review Worker into an isolated acceptance preview stack.

criteria.text: The preview creates a customer review request without production notification bindings.
criteria.verification: Run the onboarding smoke against the preview URL and attach the JSON result.

criteria.text: The review page opens from the preview URL and shows the seeded request.
criteria.verification: Attach browser evidence captured from the preview URL.
